title: Schedule of Mobile Wallet Cancellation and Refund Parameters
content:
Schedule to the **Mobile Wallet** customer terms: the cancellation window, fee refund shares and refund timing for every tier.

| Tier | Full-refund cancellation window (elapsed hours after booking) | Share of each booking fee refunded on a cancellation after the window (percent) | Paloma business days to issue a refund owed | Share of the transfer fee refunded when a recipient-side failed credit is refunded (percent) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Mobile Wallet Micro | 0.50 | 0 | 1 | 0 |
| Mobile Wallet Economy | 0.50 | 100 | 3 | 0 |
| Mobile Wallet Express | 0.50 | 0 | 1 | 0 |
| Mobile Wallet Express Plus | 0.50 | 50 | 1 | 50 |
| Mobile Wallet Priority | 0.50 | 0 | 1 | 100 |
| Mobile Wallet Large Amount | 0.50 | 100 | 2 | 0 |

- The full-refund window of 0.50 elapsed hours is the Regulation E 30-minute cancellation right, expressed in hours; within it a cancellation refunds principal and every fee in full.
- The refund period is counted in Paloma business days from the day the refund becomes owed.

*Hypothetical reading:* on Mobile Wallet Express Plus a cancellation made after the 30-minute window refunds 50 percent of each booking fee; on Mobile Wallet Micro it refunds 0 percent of each booking fee; a refund owed on a Mobile Wallet Economy transfer is issued within 3 business days.
